name: Dragon Knight
description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon’s head.

abilities.name: High Ground
abilities.description: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

abilities.name: Leaping Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

abilities.name: Comeback
abilities.description: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.
